subject: Post-demo: deployment fit & migration intent — next steps
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme.com>, Joe Miller <joe.miller@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: deployment fit & migration intent — next steps

Hi Sarah / Joe,

Thanks again for taking the demo today — great discussion. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Deployment preference: you mentioned a strong preference for private VPC due to PHI handling and internal policy, but also interest in a hybrid path (Dedicated for burst / Hosted for sandbox). We captured that as: Private VPC primary, Dedicated as optional fallback.

2) Migration sources: you plan to migrate from a mix of legacy on-prem GPU clusters (NVIDIA A100 fleet) and an existing endpoint contract with VendorX. Key constraints are: full traffic cutover within 3–4 months, zero-churn retention for existing prompt logs, and KMS integration for key management.

3) Obstacles to resolve: procurement timeline (PO required by June 15), SOC2 evidence, and a short pilot on a subset of models.

Immediate asks / proposed next steps:
- Can you confirm the migration scope (number of models & peak QPS) so Diego can size the Dedicated/VPC config? (I noted ~3 LLMs and peak ~120 qps during spikes)
- I’ve attached a short hosting comparison and a spreadsheet template for migration details — please fill the sheet and share by end of week.
- Marissa, can you prepare a procurement checklist and an estimate for Reserved capacity vs private deployment delta?

Attachments: redwood-hosting-comparison.pdf (overview), acme-migration-notes.xlsx (simple migration template)

If that all looks right I’ll schedule a technical sizing call with Diego and your infra lead. Is Thursday 5/22 10am PT plausible?

Thanks,

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Joe Miller <joe.miller@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 18:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: deployment fit & migration intent — next steps

Thanks, Sergio — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Deployment: we are leaning toward Private VPC for production given PHI. Dedicated for non-prod/beta environment would be ideal if the economics make sense. Hosted API is only for early POC.
- Migration scope: primary models are (a) clinical-extraction v2 (1.5B param), (b) notes-summarizer (7B param), (c) conversational assistant (13B param). Peak QPS: 100 sustained, 200 spike.
- KMS: we use AWS KMS (customer-managed key) and will need HSM-equivalent support.
- Procurement: procurement needs an initial SOW + high-level pricing for VPC + estimated ingress/egress. PO timeline: we’ll try to have PO in by June 12.

We started filling the spreadsheet (acme-migration-notes.xlsx) — I attached our rough sizing in the second tab. One ask: can you confirm whether Redwood’s Private control plane supports our VPC peering architecture (we use shared services VPC)?

Joe and I are available for the sizing call on Thu 5/22 10am PT — works for us.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Sr. Platform Engineer | Acme Corp
sarah.lin@acme.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: deployment fit & migration intent — next steps

Sergio / Marissa — quick internal note ahead of Thu call: 

Thanks for the model list and QPS, Sarah — that gives us a clear starting point. Initial hypotheses: 
- Private VPC will be the baseline. For the three models listed, a mixed node pool with 2x 80GB A100s for the 13B conversational model (KV cache enabled) and a couple of 40GB GPUs for smaller models should handle sustained 100 qps with autoscale headroom.
- Dedicated reserved capacity makes sense for non-prod if Acme needs identical runtime behavior without the cost of a full private deployment.
- Migration approach: staged lift-and-shift. Start with notes-summarizer (7B) in Dedicated (can be done in 2–3 weeks), then move conversation model into Private VPC for PHI workloads.

Prep for Thu: I’ll pull a ballpark pricing delta (Private VPC baseline vs Dedicated + Hosted hybrid) and a minimal SOW outline. Sergio — want me to include an explicit rollback SLA and KV cache warm-up checklist?

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Staff Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Sarah. Thu 5/22 10am PT is confirmed (calendar invite sent). Agenda for the sizing call: 
- 10:00–10:10: scope & constraints recap (Sergio)
- 10:10–10:30: infra sizing recommendations (Diego)
- 10:30–10:40: procurement & SOW outline (Marissa)
- 10:40–10:50: next steps & timelines (all)

Action items before the call: 
- Sarah / Joe: finalize model parameter lines and share any additional compliance docs (SOC2 artifact names) — thanks for the partial sheet already.
- Marissa: bring a draft pricing delta & sample SOW.
- Diego: include rollback SLA + KV warm-up checklist as discussed.

Attachments referenced earlier are in the email thread and on Drive: https://drive.redwood/reports/acme-migration-notes

See you Thu — Sergio
